Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**PLATINUM FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (metallic), lawful good*
**AC** 23 (natural armor)
**HP** 615 (30d20 + 300)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft. (hover), swim 60 ft.
**STR** 30 (+10) | **DEX** 20 (+5) | **CON** 30 (+10) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 20 (+5) | **CHA** 30 (+10)
**Saving Throws** Dex +13, Con +18, Wis +13, Cha +18
**Skills** History +11, Insight +11, Perception +21, Persuasion +18
**Immunities** radiant
**Condition Immunities** blinded, charmed, frightened
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 31
**Languages** Common, Draconic
**CR** 28 (120,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +8

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

***Innate Spellcasting.*** The dragon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. They can cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• ***1/Day each:*** prismatic wall, sunlight crest
• ***2/Day each:*** power word break, punishing gleam
• ***3/Day each:*** daylight, solar implosion

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Radiance.*** Radiant damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to radiant damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage and 20 (3d12) radiant damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options:
• ***Radiant Blast.*** The dragon breathes a blast of radiant energy targeting a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes there in a 60-foot-radius sphere of blinding radiant energy. All creatures in range must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 98 (15d12) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Blinding Flare Swarm.*** The dragon causes three spheres of radiant power to explode within 180 feet of itself, each covering a 20-foot-radius sphere. None of the spheres can overlap, and creatures caught in multiple spheres are only targeted once. Each creature caught in these spheres must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute and take 33 (6d10) radiant damage. Creatures blinded this way can reattempt the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Weave (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Blinding Shield.*** When the dragon or a creature within 60 feet of it is targeted by an attack, the dragon may create a shield of radiant power around them that increases their AC by 5 and blinds any creature making an attack roll against them on that turn. Any melee attack that strikes the shielded creature breaks the shield and ends the effect.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Move.*** The dragon moves up to its movement speed, or moves up to half its movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
***Blinding Barrage.*** The dragon conjures a series of slashing lights around a creature it can see within 60 feet. That creature must succeed a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the dragon’s next turn.
